correctness.rationale: With y=1+x and D=1+y² the first three z-derivatives at z=-x have numerators 4y, 4(3y²-1), and 48y(y²-1) over D²,D³,D⁴. They give nonnegative divided differences through order three by simplex integration, including coincident nodes. Triangular resolvent expansion therefore gives positivity for every DAG of the stated depth. For a four-state shortest route of length three, any four-transition walk would contain a removable repetition; thus Q⁴ contributes only three transitions and a negative hold (at least the source), giving strict positivity from the coefficient -1/4 when the cubic coefficient vanishes. Shorter routes use coefficients 1 and 1/2, unreachable entries are zero by reachability block structure, and conservation follows from Q1=0. For the five-state witness invert the transient denominator D I/2 - h(1+h)N + h²N²/2 modulo N⁴. Transient coefficients agree with the derivative expressions. Subtracting their partial sums from 1 gives the four absorbing numerators over D to powers 1 through 4: h(h+2), h²(h²+4h+2), h⁴(h²+6h+6), h⁴(h⁴+8h³+12h²-4). The last quartic is strictly increasing on h>0 and crosses zero exactly once. The transient block has three internal superdiagonal ones, not four as one incidental sentence says; the displayed generator and N⁴=0 calculation are correct.
